topics.name: Precision and Rounding Profile
topics.purpose: Define reusable numeric precision, rounding, overflow and comparison tolerance semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each precision/rounding profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.precision_rule: Scale/significant digits or exact representation is explicit.
semantics.comparison_rule: Tolerance/equality semantics are explicit where approximate.
semantics.calculation_rule: Intermediate vs final rounding points are explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Rounding cannot relax policy thresholds unless policy explicitly uses the rounded representation.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: binary float accepted for exact money silently
